housing.summary: Current one-bedroom Al Khor listings are available on Property Finder Qatar; the opened page does not establish an average city-centre rent or deposit norm.

banking.summary: Qatar Islamic Bank's official newcomer page says expatriate applicants need a valid QID, passport copy, employment contract or salary certificate, and residence-address details.

schools.summary: Al Khor International School officially offers British Curriculum and India's CBSE pathway; Qatar's Ministry of Education and Higher Education provides the linked private-school directory.
curricula: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) of India

legal_admin.summary: For a new residence-permit application, the Ministry of Public Health service requires the applicant to visit the Medical Commission Department as soon as possible after entering Qatar for a medical examination.
legal_admin.registration_step: Visit the Medical Commission Department as soon as possible after entering Qatar and complete the medical examination required for residence-permit issuance.

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer who must register for income tax can register through the General Tax Authority's Dhareeba Tax Portal to obtain a Tax Identification Number.

transport.summary: Sila is Qatar's integrated transport-network brand covering metro, bus, taxi and tram. For public healthcare, residents apply for a health card at the nearest PHCC health centre; requirements are documented at https://www.phcc.gov.qa/patients-clients/health-card.
transport.healthcare_registration: Visit the nearest PHCC health centre, complete the form, and provide a valid QID, 4cm x 3cm photo, credit/debit card for the QAR 100 adult-resident fee, and a utility-bill copy as proof of residence. Source: https://www.phcc.gov.qa/patients-clients/health-card
